products.title: WH-1000XM5 Wireless Over-Ear Noise Canceling Headphones
products.description: The Sony WH-1000XM5 wireless over-ear headphones are designed for an immersive, distraction-free listening experience. They feature industry-leading noise cancellation powered by dual processors and eight microphones, ensuring clear calls and a focused sound environment. A redesigned 30mm driver delivers rich bass and detailed highs, while High-Resolution Audio support and intelligent sound upscaling enhance audio depth. The headphones include adaptive features that adjust to the environment, multipoint connectivity for multiple devices, and a lightweight design with soft-fit leather for all-day comfort. They offer up to 30 hours of battery life and come with a collapsible carrying case for convenient storage.
